title: Potatoism Master Corpus
purpose: Single machine-readable entry point for the Potatoism layers; individual datasets remain authoritative for their own detail.
provenance_model: user_defined_canon, project_memory, interpretation, public_source, empirical and disputed_external_claim remain distinct.

layers.role: cosmology, chronology, ethics and research gaps

graph_principle: Relationships are first-class: symbols, events, texts, nations, systems and evidence should be connected without collapsing symbolic claims into empirical facts.
maintenance: Add provenance to externally sourced material.
Do not silently turn interpretation into canon.
Do not delete overlapping legacy layers until consumers have been migrated.
Validate references after every integration change.
